input.title: ZM3D Halloween iPad 12.9" store screenshot set
input.description:
Halloween version of the live iPad 12.9" App Store set (live since Sep 17). The iPhone 6.5" and Google Play phone Halloween sets are already exported in ZM3D Halloween 2025 / Store. The iPad set is the only store screenshot set still missing.

**Direction (Robert's Seasonal art direction, Q4 2025):** keep the same comps as the live iPad set and add only the seasonal layer (pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment). Same flat background, same pose, same zombie order, same CTA. Match the iPhone 6.5" Halloween set.

**Due:** Wed Oct 15, exported to ZM3D Halloween 2025 / Store. Hard cut is Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT: iOS screenshots can only change with a new version, so this set goes up with the Oct 17 submission. Live from about Wed Oct 22 after Apple review. It reverts to normal with the Nov 6 submission.

Plan + tracker: see Claire's ZM3D Halloween plan doc / tracker (linked in #zombie_marketing).

input.title: ZM3D Halloween app icon (simple version, App Store + Google Play)
input.description:
Halloween version of the live app icon (live on both stores since Sep 17).

**Direction:** On Sep 17 in #zombie-art, Robert said the Sep 17 AppIconHalloween draft gets too busy at icon size, and a Halloween icon should stay as simple as the current one. Keep the current icon and add one light seasonal touch, per the Seasonal art direction deck. Get Robert's OK on the comp first.

**Due:** Wed Oct 15, final assets handed to Arthur for the build. Hard cut is the Oct 16 12:00 PT merge cut: on iOS the icon ships inside the build, so it can only go live with the Oct 17 submission, from about Wed Oct 22 after Apple review. We can't swap it on Oct 24 by itself, so we're matching the stores on Oct 22: upload the Google Play icon Tue Oct 21 (1-day review). It reverts with the Nov 6 submission.

Plan + tracker: see Claire's ZM3D Halloween plan doc / tracker (linked in #zombie_marketing).

input.title: ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan
input.bodyText:
ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art). For the Thu Oct 2 Halloween review. Please comment directly in this doc.
Tracker (every item, call, owner and due date): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YLNZhvET932ufaPknejofeIkOBfawSBzvpcjsObCfBU/edit

1. Goal
Leonard wants everything players see from us to look like Halloween for the last stretch of October: the store pages and every ad we're running. This plan covers everything live today (Oct 1), the Halloween call for each piece, who makes it, and by when.

2. What's live today
Store: app icon, iPhone 6.5" set and iPad 12.9" set (App Store), and the Google Play phone set. All live since Sep 17.
Ads: 58 Unity creatives across iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet, Android US phone and Android US tablet. That's the 56 on the ZM3D live creatives sheet plus two that are running but missing from the sheet:
- ART-826 julia 4:5 static ("They're coming, stop them!"): still on iOS UK and still our best CPI there (Frederick's comment on the ZM roadmap Halloween card).
- ART-831 Marcus's portrait UA end card: plays after every Android US phone video (Frederick, checked Sep 29).
Frederick, can we add both to the sheet?

3. Inputs and the rules they set
- Frederick's Sep 30 UA changes: Android US tablet ends Sun Oct 12 and its budget moves to iOS UK, so no Halloween versions of anything that only runs there. The Halloween flight is Sat Oct 18 - Fri Oct 31 on iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet and Android US phone. Every Halloween ad has to be with Frederick by Wed Oct 15 so Unity can approve it before the flight. This replaces the Oct 17 date in his Sep 12 draft.
- Arthur's Q4 release calendar: the Oct 17 submission is the last build that can carry Halloween. The merge cut is Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT. New iOS screenshots (and the icon, which ships in the build) must be in by then. Apple review takes up to 3 days, so plan on the iOS build and listing being live from about Wed Oct 22. Google Play listing graphics aren't tied to a build: upload any day and allow 1 day for review. The Nov 6 submission puts the icon and screenshots back to normal.
- Robert's Seasonal art direction (Q4 2025): seasonal dressing only goes on top of current art. Anything captured or rendered from a build older than Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the Jul 29 zombie swap with the new background) is redone on the current build first. If a later capture has replaced it, the newest capture counts. A video whose master has music baked in is re-cut from a no-music master first. Only the seasonal layer changes (pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment); background, pose, zombie order and CTA stay the same so each variant tests clean against its normal version.
- Calls (from Robert's deck): Halloween version = dress it from the current art. Refresh first = re-capture, re-render or re-cut, then the Halloween pass. Reuse = a Halloween version already exists. Skip = no Halloween version this time.
- Who makes what (Leonard): Martin does the icon and stills (store screenshots and Julia's statics). Marcus does video and end cards.
- Store tickets (Leonard, #zombie-art Sep 30): store art that's already exported is done and needs no ticket. Tickets are only for store art that still has to be made.

4. Store pages
- App icon: Halloween version, Martin, new ticket ART-856. The Sep 17 draft was too busy at icon size, and Robert wants it as simple as the current icon. Due Wed Oct 15 to Arthur; the hard cut is the Oct 16 12:00 PT merge.
  On swapping the icon around the 24th: on iOS the icon is part of the build, so the only Halloween window is the Oct 17 submission, live about Oct 22. It can't change on Oct 24 by itself. Proposal: upload the Google Play icon Tue Oct 21 so both stores switch on Oct 22. Both revert with the Nov 6 submission.
- iPhone 6.5" set: Reuse. Martin's Halloween set (5 screens) is already in ZM3D Halloween 2025 / Store and goes up with the Oct 17 submission. Live about Oct 22.
- iPad 12.9" set: Halloween version, Martin, new ticket ART-855. No Halloween iPad set exists yet. Due Wed Oct 15; hard cut Oct 16 12:00 PT.
- Google Play phone set: Reuse. Martin's Halloween set (6 screens) is already exported. Upload Fri Oct 17 so it's live Sat Oct 18 with the flight.

5. Ads (58)
Summary: 14 Halloween versions, 34 refresh first, 2 reuse, 8 skip. Every ad call and due date is also commented on its ART ticket, and every ad that needs new work is assigned to its maker.
Due dates: refresh-first work by Wed Oct 8, so the Halloween pass still has a week. Every Halloween ad to Frederick by Wed Oct 15.

Reuse (2), ready now:
- ART-808 cheer fastcouch 9:16 and ART-816 cheer fastcouch 16:9: Marcus's Halloween cuts from the no-music masters are already in ZM3D Halloween 2025 / UA masters. Frederick can queue them now.

Halloween version (14). All current captures (Android #1529 or later) with no-music masters:
- Marcus: ART-795 couch alpha 50, ART-797 balloons alpha 50 (1), ART-805 barrel marketing2 4:5, ART-817 / 818 / 819 marcus.bennett 16:9, 4:5, 1:1, ART-833 / 834 / 835 / 848 end card 001 (9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5), ART-851 cheer fastcouch 4:5, ART-852 barrel marketing2 1:1, ART-853 couch alpha 50 4:5, ART-854 balloons alpha 50 (1) 16:9.

Refresh first (34):
- Marcus, pre-#1452 captures: ART-793 couch boss 30, ART-794 couch alpha 30, ART-800 / 801 / 803 / 804 9:16 endcard cuts, ART-810 / 811 squirrelfail, ART-812 / 813 mrfluffernot, ART-814 / 815 / 845 / 846 cinematic tutorials (all prototype captures from Dec 2024), ART-823 couch alpha 50 16:9 (re-export from the Sep 22 #1935 re-capture), ART-831 portrait UA end card (rendered from #1450, two builds before the swap), ART-832 end card template 16:9, ART-840 boris fastcouch 9:16 (gameplay captured Jul 28), ART-841 / 850 boris alin2, ART-843 couch boss 30 16:9.
- Marcus, pre-#1452 AND music baked into the master (re-capture and cut a no-music master): ART-796 balloons alpha 50, ART-798 barrel alpha 30, ART-799 couch marketing2 30s, ART-802 couch alpha 30 endcard, ART-807 cheer 30p 9:16, ART-847 cheer 30p 4:5.
- Marcus, current capture but music baked in: ART-809 marcus.bennett 9:16. Re-cut it from his Aug 13 no-music export (InvestorFacing_Seq3_NoMusic).
- Martin, Julia's statics, all made from Android #852 captures (Jun 5): ART-825 julia 1:1, ART-826 julia 4:5 (best iOS UK CPI, so prioritise it), ART-827 julia 9:16, ART-828 julia 16:9, ART-829 julia 1:1 android 1080, ART-830 julia 4:5 android 1080x1350.

Skip (8). They only run on Android US tablet, which ends Oct 12:
- ART-806 barrel marketing2 16:9, ART-820 cheer 30p 16:9, ART-821 couch alpha 30 16:9, ART-822 balloons alpha 50 16:9, ART-824 barrel alpha 30 endcard 16:9, ART-842 boris fastcouch 16:9, ART-844 couch marketing2 30s 16:9, ART-849 julia 1:1 android tablet.

6. Who makes what, by when
- Marcus Bennett: 28 refresh-first by Wed Oct 8, then 42 Halloween ads (28 refreshed + 14 straight Halloween) to Frederick by Wed Oct 15.
- Martin Walsh: 6 Julia statics refreshed by Wed Oct 8 and Halloween to Frederick by Wed Oct 15. Icon (ART-856) and iPad set (ART-855) by Wed Oct 15.
- Frederick Stone: queue the Halloween uploads as they land (the 2 reuse cuts are ready now). Flight Sat Oct 18 - Fri Oct 31.
- Arthur Blake: icon and iPhone + iPad Halloween screenshots in the Oct 17 submission (merge cut Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT). Normal art back in the Nov 6 submission.
- Store uploads: Google Play screenshots on Fri Oct 17, Google Play icon on Tue Oct 21, swapped back for the Nov 6 clean-up. Leonard, who owns these uploads?

7. Risks and open questions
- Marcus's load: 42 ads, 28 of them re-captures first. If that's too much by Oct 15, we can drop the weakest refresh-first ads to Skip rather than put a stale build in a Halloween ad. Frederick, can you rank the refresh-first ads by spend?
- The icon has the least slack: Robert has to sign off on a simpler comp, and engineering has to merge it before noon PT Oct 16.
- The live creatives sheet is missing ART-826 and ART-831. Both are in this plan.
- Halloween props: the Halloween pack we already use (pumpkins, fog) covers the dressing, so we don't need the outside props bundle that was pitched to me.

text:
Halloween art plan and tracker are ready for Thursday's review. Both are shared with everyone on the invite so you can comment:
• Plan: https://docs.google.com/document/d/37dbe022571a2be12f93ffe1/edit
• Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YLNZhvET932ufaPknejofeIkOBfawSBzvpcjsObCfBU/edit

The short version:
• **Ads (58 live):** 14 get a Halloween version, 34 need a refresh first (pre-#1452 captures or music baked into the master), 2 reuse Marcus's existing cheer fastcouch Halloween cuts, and 8 are skipped because they only run on Android US tablet, which ends Oct 12. Every ART ticket has its call and due date in a comment. The 48 that need work are assigned to Marcus (videos and end cards) or Martin (Julia's statics). Refreshes are due Wed Oct 8, and every Halloween ad goes to Frederick by Wed Oct 15 for the Oct 18-31 flight.
• **Two ads missing from the live sheet:** julia 4:5 (ART-826, our best iOS UK CPI) and Marcus's portrait end card (ART-831). Both are in the plan.
• **Store:** the iPhone and Google Play Halloween sets are already exported (reuse). New tickets: <https://linear.app/harmonygames/issue/ART-855|ART-855> for the iPad 12.9" set and <https://linear.app/harmonygames/issue/ART-856|ART-856> for a simpler icon, both Martin, due Oct 15.
• **Icon timing:** we can't swap it on the 24th by itself, because on iOS the icon ships in the build. Its only window is the Oct 17 submission (merge cut Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT), live around Oct 22. Proposal: upload the Google Play icon Oct 21 so both stores switch on Oct 22, and revert with the Nov 6 submission.
